integrity: The known Peres–Mermin square is credited. An October 2026 paper already exhibits the exact endpoint contrast in a different entangled state; the present distinct claim is a universal upper proof and a separable sharp optimizer. No external audit or priority guarantee is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Two-qubit exact equal-modulus expectation constraint; no assertion for higher qubit counts, approximate flatness, sign-pattern uniqueness, physical noise or operational quantum advantage.
title: Sharp two-qubit Pauli-flat contrast with a separable nonstabilizer endpoint
